title: queryChanges chat filter does O(N) per-message DB reads
description: MessageQueryChangesHandler lock 1 (message.rs lines 850-863) calls guard.messages().get(id) once per ID returned by get_changes_since. get_changes_since returns ALL messages changed across ALL chats since the given state. For a deployment with multiple active chats and many messages, this is O(N) individual SELECT queries where N is the total cross-chat change count, just to filter down to one chat. The store layer already has the chat_id column on the messages table; the fix is to add a get_changes_since_for_chat(chat_id, since_state) store method that filters in SQL rather than in Rust.
